description: OMENZ Robot Action Gate: call before ONE physical action from a third-party skill or loadout. Checks the signed install receipt (or loadout), the capability, speed and payload limits, no-go zones, forbidden capabilities (face ID), people/children nearby and the human-confirm list: ALLOW / CONFIRM_FIRST / DENY + a signed receipt for the audit trail. The robot's own safety system still has the last word. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/robot/action-gate, $0.002 via x402.)
